XData.name: PageContents
XData.Description: This XML block defines the contents of this pane.
XData.Data:
<pane xmlns="http://www.intersystems.com/zen" width="100%">
<hgroup valign="top" width="100%" align="left"> <!-- Create --> <vgroup valign="top" align="left" width="30%"> <fieldSet id="srcCtrlInFieldSet" legend=" Create / Find Deployment Files " width="100%"> <form id="srcCtrlInForm" layout="vertical" cellStyle="padding: 2px; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px;" width="100%"> <text label="Component:" id="Component" name="Component" size="50"/> <text label="Namespace:" id="Namespace" name="Namespace" size="25"/>
</form> <spacer height="20"/> <hgroup align="center"> <button caption="Create Deployment" onclick="zenPage.DoCreateFiles();" title="Create a new deployment file" /> <spacer width="10"/> <button caption="Find Deployment" onclick="zenPage.FindFiles();" title="Find all deployment files for a component" /> </hgroup> <spacer height="10" width="10"/> <fieldSet id="Settings" hidden="false" legend="Component Settings " width="100%" align="center">
<spacer height="20"/> <radioSet id="envRS" name="envRS" displayList="QA,UAT,PROD" valueList="QA,UAT,PROD" value="QA" align="center" /> <spacer height="10"/>
<button id="buttonFindSetting" align="center" caption="Find Settings" onclick="zenPage.FindSettings();" title="Find Settings file" />
</fieldSet> <spacer height="20" width="20"/>
<fieldSet id="SettingsWebPage" hidden="false" legend="To edit the settings" width="100%"> <vgroup align="center" title="Edit page"> <spacer height="20"/> <button id="editSettings" align="left" onclick="zenPage.changeEditSettingsPage();" caption="Edit Settings Web Page"/>
</vgroup> </fieldSet>
</fieldSet> </vgroup> <!-- Deploy -->
<vgroup valign="top" align="center" width="30%"> <fieldSet id="deployFieldSet" hidden="false" legend=" Deploy Files " width="100%"> <form id="deployForm" layout="vertical" cellStyle="padding: 2px; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px;"> <text label="File (Comma separated file on the server):" id="deployFile" name="DeployFile" size="50" title="Compnent,Namespace,Version"/> <text label="Component:" id="deployComponent" name="Component" size="50" /> <text label="Namespace:" id="deployNamespace" name="Namespace" size="25"/> <hgroup align="left"> <label id="lblRev" value="Deployment revision # " title="Version # from Find Deployment" /> <text id="deployRev" name="Rev" required="true" size="10" align="left" title="Version # from Find Deployment"/> </hgroup> <spacer height="20"/>
<hgroup> <label id="lblfType" value="Deploy Type: " /> <combobox id="comboboxdeployType" editable="false" dropdownHeight="40" onchange="zenPage.ChangeDeployType();" selectedIndex="1" > <option value="new" text="New"/> <option value="update" text="Update"/> </combobox> </hgroup>
<spacer height="10" width="20"/> <fieldSet id="settingsGrp">
<hgroup align="left"> <vgroup width="100%"> <checkbox caption="Update the Settings" value="0" id="UpdateSettings" title="Update the Settings" /> <spacer height="10"/>
<hgroup align="left"> <label id="lblSettingsRev" value="Settings revision # " title="Version # from Find Settings" /> <text id="settingRev" name="Rev" required="true" size="10" align="left" title="Version # from Find Settings"/> </hgroup>
</vgroup> </hgroup> <spacer height="10" width="20"/> <fieldSet id="redeployGrp" hidden="true" > <spacer height="10" width="20"/> <checkbox caption="Redeploy BPL, DTL Classes" id="DeployClasses" value="0" title="Redeploy New BPL, DTL Classes" /> <!-- <spacer height="10" width="20"/> <checkbox caption="Redeploy Config (Overwrite settings)" value="0" id="DeployConfig" title="Redeploy Config - Will Overwrite the current settings!" /> -->
<spacer height="10" width="20"/> <checkbox caption="Change the class" value="0" id="ChangeClass" title="Change the class. Change a production item to use a different underlying class!" />
<spacer height="20"/>
</fieldSet> </fieldSet>
<spacer height="10" width="20"/> <hgroup align="center"> <button id="buttonDep" caption="Deploy" onclick="zenPage.DoDeploy();" title="Deploy a file" />
</hgroup> </form>
</fieldSet>
</vgroup>
<!-- Verify -->
<vgroup valign="top" align="right" width="30%" > <fieldSet id="verFieldSet" hidden="false" legend=" Verify Files " width="100%"> <form id="verForm" layout="vertical" cellStyle="padding: 2px; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px;"> <text label="Component:" id="verComponent" name="Component" size="50" /> <text label="Namespace:" id="verNamespace" name="Namespace" size="25" />
<hgroup align="center"> <button id="buttonVer" caption="Verify" onclick="zenPage.DoVerify();" title="Verify if all classes are unmodified for a component" />
</hgroup> </form>
</fieldSet>
</vgroup>
</hgroup> <label id="lblAccess" value="" />
</pane>
